headline: Rams put Davante Adams, Poona Ford on IR
summary: Wide receiver Davante Adams is expected to miss the next 6-10 weeks after rupturing his hamstring in last Sunday's loss to the Cardinals and the Rams moved him off of the active roster on Tuesday.

headline: Colts To Contact Peyton Manning About GM Job?
